sn11.13:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane kuṭāgāra-sālāyaṃ || || 3.
sn11.13:1.3: Atha kho Mahāli licchavi yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam nisīdi || || 4. Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Mahāli licchavi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn11.13:2.1: Diṭṭho no bhante Bhagavatā Sakko devānam indo ti || || 5.
sn11.13:3.1: Diṭṭho kho me Mahāli Sakko devānam indo ti || || 6.
sn11.13:4.1: So hi nūna bhante sakkapaṭirūpako bhavissati ||
sn11.13:4.2: duddaso hi bhante Sakko devānam indo ti || || 7.
sn11.13:5.1: Sakkañcāham Mahāli jānāmi sakkakaraṇe ca dhamme yesaṃ dhammānaṃ samādinnattā Sakko sakkattam ajjhagā tañ ca pajānāmi || || 8.
sn11.13:6.1: Sakko Mahāli devānam indo pubbe manussabhūto samāno Magho nāma māṇavako ahosi || tasmā Maghavā ti vuccati || || 9.
sn11.13:7.1: Sakko Mahāli devānam indo pubbe manussabhūto samāno pure pure dānam adāsi || tasmā Purindado ti vuccati || || 10. Sakko Mahāli devānam indo pubbe manussabhūto samāno sakkaccaṃ dānam adāsi || tasmā Sakko ti vuccati || || 11.
sn11.13:9.1: devānam indo pubbe manussabhūto samāno āvasatham adāsi || tasmā Vāsavo ti vuccati || || 12.
sn11.13:10.1: Sakko Mahāli devānam indo sahassam pi atthānam muhuttena cinteti || tasmā Sahassakkho ti vuccati || || 13.
sn11.13:11.1: Sakkassa Mahāli devānam indassa Sujā nāma asurakaññā pajāpatī || tasmā Sujampatīti vuccati || || 14.
sn11.13:12.1: Sakko Mahāli devānam indo devānam Tāvatiṃsānam issariyādhipaccam rajjaṃ kāresi || tasmā devānam indo vuccati || || 15.
sn11.13:13.1: Sakkassa Mahāli devānam indassa pubbe manussabhūtassa satta vatapadāni samattāni samādinnāni ahesuṃ || yesaṃ samādinnattā Sakko sakkattam ajjhagā || || 16.
sn11.13:13.7: Yāva jīvaṃ vigatamalamacchereṇa cetasā agāram ajjhāvaseyyam muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato || ||
sn11.13:13.9: Yāvajīvaṃ akodhano assaṃ || sa ce pi me kodho uppajjeyya khippam eva nam paṭivineyyan ti || || 18.
sn11.13:13.10: Sakkassa Mahāli devānam indassa pubbe manussabhūtassa imāni satta vatapadāni samattāni samādinnāni ahesuṃ || yesaṃ samādinnattā Sakko sakkattam ajjhagā ti || ||
